desc.olmos: A two-bedroom flat on a high floor with a front balcony and morning light. Separate kitchen, bedrooms at the back and a well-kept building two blocks from the park.
desc.ceibo: A two-bedroom flat in a nineties building, with a balcony and roomy spaces. Mortgage-eligible, with low building fees.
desc.ribera: A duplex with its own terrace facing the river, a garage and three bedrooms. Double-height living room and a grill on the terrace.
desc.colinas: A house on its own lot with a garden and pool, three bedrooms and a barbecue house. Quiet street, minutes from the highway.
desc.parque: A front-facing PH with no building fees, a patio and lots of light. Two bedrooms and room to extend on the roof.
desc.loft: A brand-new loft downtown with big windows and double height. Good to live in or to rent out; mortgage-eligible.

sim.title: You decide what happens tonight
sim.body: Nothing moves on its own. Tap “Simulate” and follow the 11:40 PM inquiry: reply, qualification, viewing and follow-up. Switch the guided chat off to see the same night without it.

chat.title: Every inquiry, answered in seconds
chat.body: The guided chat replies at any hour: with buttons it asks how they'll pay and their budget, and leaves the lead file ready. You can answer for Carolina.

site.title: Your website searches and books
site.body: Filters by area, rooms and price, a listing page with the floor plan and “Book a viewing”. Book one: it shows up in the calendar and the pipeline.

pipeline.title: A pipeline that sorts itself
pipeline.body: Each lead goes from New to Qualified, Viewing and Reserved as Lumi moves forward. Drag a card or use “Move” to sort it by hand.

visits.title: Viewings without the back-and-forth
visits.body: Both agents in one calendar. Switch between week and day, browse past and future weeks and tap a free time to book.

followups.title: A follow-up after every viewing
followups.body: Confirmation, reminder and “how did you like it?” on WhatsApp, with the property and their name. That is how a viewing turns into a reservation.

contacts.title: Every contact, with their whole story
contacts.body: Where they came from, what they want, their viewings, their tasks and everything that happened, in one file. Leave a note or add a task: it goes into the history.

brand.title: Your brand, from the setup
brand.body: Included in the plan: a refined identity, the website and listings in your brand, two audited profiles, 12 hooks, 6 example videos and the operating guide. Compare “Base template” and “With your brand”.

simContact.title: You decide what happens tonight
simContact.body: Nothing moves on its own. Tap “Simulate” and follow the 11:40 PM inquiry: the guided chat answers, the lead is qualified and it ends with a viewing in the calendar.
